draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.49, the 11th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 1st of 20 at S. He lasted until pick 45, well after his grade rank (11th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Minkah Fitzpatrick. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (16th percentile), 20-yard shuttle (1st percentile). College production: 90 tackles in 2022, 5th of 20 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Detroit Lions (physically unable to perform). 43 career games and 37 starts over 3 completed seasons. Trending down from his peak: 4 AV in 2025 against a career-best 8 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: missed tackle rate 3.9% (93rd percentile), passes defended 9 (89th percentile). Weak spots: interceptions 0 (22nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 safety who played: 67.6% season snap share against a median of 51.8%, above the norm.
